description: AWS Service Role Trust Missing Source Context Restriction
rationale: A role allows a supported AWS service principal to call sts:AssumeRole without aws:SourceArn or aws:SourceAccount conditions. This is a confused-deputy hardening candidate: only ECS tasks, CodeDeploy, AWS Config and CodeBuild service roles are evaluated.
remediation: Review service-specific AWS guidance; where supported restrict trust with aws:SourceAccount and/or aws:SourceArn scoped to your account and resource. Confirm proper permissions before rollout.
